title: Why site November 5 was targeted
summary: Mario Woods tells of Why site November 5 was targeted, about 1977 at Site November 5, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Site November 5, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: why November 5, the closest to a town, the closest to the launch control facility and the least amount of travel time for all other nine missiles?

plain: Mario Woods, a former US Air Force man, describes a 1977 event at a nuclear missile site called November 5, part of the missile field run from Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota. Speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, he asks why that site would have been picked, and says it was the closest to a town, the closest to the control centre that runs the missiles, and the quickest to reach from the other nine missiles. In his view the choice was deliberate, which would mean whatever came there knew the layout of the base.
